# audio-loudness-normalizer

> Measure integrated loudness per ITU-R BS.1770-4 with K-weighting and gating, then normalize PCM WAV audio to a LUFS target with a sample-peak ceiling, in pure Python Python package `trysac-audio-loudness-normalizer`, import name `audio_loudness_normalizer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
